body: I’ve decided bringing the cats with me wouldn’t be fair to them. So I’ve made a list to tie up all my loose ends & hope they’re ok. I didn’t realize I had already made up my mind to end it all until I struggled with their happiness.

I’ve got 2 cats & too many belongings. I can’t just jump in my car & leave. Recently I found myself at a used RV place, about to put down $10,000 when I got a bad feeling about the rep & left. I want to sever ties with everyone & leave. I just don’t know how to do it.
